main_text.p: ἀρξαθαι τοῦτον μὴ ὑποστολῆς λέγειν τῷ ὁ τῷ συμ-βάλῳ [?] ἀπο-φαίνεσθαι, ὡς ἔφη ἐγὼ φωνεῖ [?]· καὶ τῷ ὑποκρινεῖν ἀδίκας, παλινῳδίαν ἦσε, ὁ δι-αφερόμενος Σωδώρῳ, τοῦτο καὶ πρῶτος μένας ἡ ἐρᾶτο [?] πίστεως, μὴ ἄλλως φρονεῖν ὁμολογῆ, καὶ ἐχυρίζεσθαι τὸ ἅγιον πνεῦμα ἐκπορεύ-εσθαι, ἡ ὡς ... τῆς ὡρᾶς, καὶ Διοκτήσεως οἰκουμενικῆς Σωώδῳ ἱερὸν σύμβολον [?], καὶ ... τὴν ἐξῆς ἀξίων Σωώδων τὸ κύριον ... διαμεμένον ...
Tempore etiam Photij, Constantinopoli, iussu pij Imperatoris Basilij Macedonis Synodus trecentorum & amplius Antistitum coacta est, quae praescribitur, sancta, & Oecumenica Synodus Prima & Secunda.
Synodo aderant, qui & opinionem, & circa potissima dogmata sententiam aliarum Ecclesiarum sibi assumpserant, erantque aliys nuncia-turi.

Causa propter quam ea Synodus celebrata est, fuit, ut Nicolaus ab Ecclesia eijceretur, quod ille eo tempore coepisset remisse dicere additionem in Symbolo, qui ut se deprehensum agnovit, veritus ne eijceretur, palinodiam cantavit, & oratoribus missis ad Synodum, innovationem a se factam Fidei denegabat; nec aliter sentire se profitebatur, contendebatque de Spiritus sancti processione, quam uti Prima & Secunda Synodus universalis sanctum Symbolum ab aliys universalibus Synodis acceptum te-

page.notes: The Greek lines are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words marked [?] are best readings; the Greek sequence after the first few words of the opening paragraph could not be confirmed letter by letter and may contain errors. Latin spelling was normalised only for u/v and i/j as instructed. Scan also shows a stray pen mark at the lower right margin, which is not text and was left out. Catchword "te-" and signature "L 4" are as printed.
